# shebang-regex [![Build Status](https://travis-ci.org/sindresorhus/shebang-regex.svg?branch***REMOVED***master)](https://travis-ci.org/sindresorhus/shebang-regex)

> Regular expression for matching a [shebang](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shebang_(Unix)) line


## Install

```
$ npm install shebang-regex
```


## Usage

```js
const shebangRegex ***REMOVED*** require('shebang-regex');

const string ***REMOVED*** '#!/usr/bin/env node\nconsole.log("unicorns");';

shebangRegex.test(string);
//***REMOVED***> true

shebangRegex.exec(string)[0];
//***REMOVED***> '#!/usr/bin/env node'

shebangRegex.exec(string)[1];
//***REMOVED***> '/usr/bin/env node'
```
